capabilities: Toggle heading capitalization between Sentence and Associated Press styles via hotkey
Change heading levels individually or in groups
Apply formatting to the current note or the whole vault
Configure settings and enable an optional third formatting style
extras: Author solicits donations via Ko-fi; the optional third formatting style is described as coming with a warning. Install is also possible via GitHub or Ko-fi Shop.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to normalize heading capitalization or batch-adjust heading levels, so headers can end up inconsistent across notes.
summary: Header formatting plugin that rewrites heading capitalization (Sentence or AP style) and adjusts heading levels in a note or across the vault.
